host.title: Player IP address (optional)
host.description: Detected player **{name}**. Enter the IP address to enable status polling and media playback over port 8899, or leave empty to use RS-232 only.

manual.title: Manual configuration
manual.description: Fill in at least one of serial port or IP address. When both are set, IP is tried first and serial is used as fallback.

error.cannot_connect_http: Cannot reach the HiChannelTV HTTP service on port 8899. Check the IP address and network.
error.cannot_connect_serial: No response on the serial port. Check the cable and baud rate.
error.no_connection: Please provide a serial port or an IP address.
